map.积分值不值钱？输入积分数与兑换商品的现金价值，算出每万分价值，对比常见兑换渠道判: Are your points worth it? Enter the points and the cash value of the redeemed item to compute value per 10k points and compare common redemption channels to judge value.
map.每万分价值 = 商品现金价值 / 兑换所需积分 × 10000: Value per 10k points = item cash value / points required × 10000
map.基于积分价值模型：以兑换所需积分与商品现金价值算得每万分对应的现金价值，并与常见: Based on a points-value model: the cash value per 10k points is derived from points required and item cash value, compared with common channels, for credit-card points usage decisions.
map.先阅读Points Redemption Value的输入说明，使用一组可复现的: First read the input instructions for Points Redemption Value, run it once with a reproducible set of sample parameters and record the result.
map.1 万积分可兑 10 元，即每积分价值 0.001 元；与年费成本比较可判断是否: 10k points redeem 10 yuan, i.e. each point worth 0.001 yuan; compare with the annual-fee cost to judge whether keeping the card is worth it.
map.每万分价值 = (兑换品价值-加钱) ÷ 积分数 × 10000: Value per 10k points = (item value − top-up) ÷ points × 10000
map.现金抵扣常见 5-10 元/万分，实物兑换 15-30 元/万分: Cash redemption commonly 5–10 yuan per 10k; physical items 15–30 yuan per 10k
